snippet.title: Terminal ESC - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809460/Terminal_ESC/
NO DOCS. NO TUTORIAL. NO ESCAPE. Tackle an evolving spectrum of puzzles within a simulated computer system using only terminal commands. Inspired by a bad day with a package manager.
